recent_runs: Essentially new to running. Regularly active: Peloton rides and Peloton toning classes, weekly yoga.
training_notes: Committed workout days are Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday ONLY - schedule every session on those three days and mark every other day Rest. Monday is her yoga day and a hard rest day from running. Some weekends she may swap Saturday to Sunday herself; always write Saturday. Her single goal: RUN the entire half marathon - no walk breaks on race day, no time goal. Use run/walk to build safely early, but aim the whole progression at continuous-running durability; she should reach 30+ continuous minutes well before the halfway point of the plan. She owns a Peloton and loves the Peloton app toning classes (abs/core). She is happy to pair a shorter run with a toning class, or do a Peloton ride plus a toning class. In the early weeks you may prescribe the Tuesday or Thursday slot as a Peloton Zone 2 ride if it aids adaptation; as the plan builds, prioritize running - she should be running 3x/week for most of the block. Append toning classes as 'Optional after: Peloton app toning/core class (10-20 min)' on shorter days - never program their content. There are no gym/strength prescriptions in this plan; her strength work is the Peloton toning classes. From the later build phase onward (roughly the final 10-12 weeks), you MAY add a 4th weekly session - a short easy run or Peloton ride on Wednesday or Sunday - but ONLY if it makes a material difference to her running the whole distance; never exceed 5 sessions in any week and default to 3 days.
